profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which the company's site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The site says IXL is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates. The company also describes IXL as offering a comprehensive K-12 curriculum, individualized guidance, and real-time analytics.

Two IXL Learning products are tracked: IXL, listed under Education and Research AI with adaptive practice and diagnostic features for teachers, students, and families, and Vocabulary.com, listed with adaptive vocabulary practice for students and teachers. Pricing for IXL is reported from a secondary source at $299 per year for a classroom license of 25 students and from $9.95 per month for family plans. Vocabulary.com district licenses are by quote, and one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127. The product notes state that student age and privacy details were not verified, and that the IXL pricing comes from a secondary source only.
